papers.title: 3D-CBM: A Framework for Concept-Based Interpretability in Generative 3D Modeling
papers.authors: Ahmad Al-Kabbany
papers.affiliations: Ahmad Al-Kabbany - Yubree Labs, Ottawa K2M1T2, Canada Ahmad Al-Kabbany - Multimedia Interaction and Communication Lab, Arab Academy for Science and Technology, Alexandria 21937, Egypt
papers.intro: 本文提出了3D-CBM框架，首次将概念瓶颈模型形式化地集成到3D生成管线中，通过多层级概念分类器实现点云/网格生成的可解释性与测试时人类干预。

papers.title: From Simulation to Real-World: An In-Field 6D Pose Dataset and Baseline for Robotic Strawberry Harvesting
papers.authors: Woojung Son, Won Suk Lee, Zijing Huang, Daeun Choi, Catia Silva, Yu She, Yan Gu
papers.affiliations: University of Florida, Purdue University
papers.intro: 本文首次在真实草莓田间收集12,040张6D位姿真值图像，并构建了场景级真实感的合成数据集，通过基线实验量化了sim-to-real差距，证明合成数据训练的性能显著低于真实数据，且深度翻译误差是主要瓶颈。

papers.title: NSVQ: Mitigating Codebook Collapse by Stabilizing Encoder Drift in Vector Quantization
papers.authors: Hao Lu, Yongxin Guo, Onur Koyun, Zhengjie Zhu, Abbas Alili, Metin N. Gurcan
papers.affiliations: Hao Lu - Wake Forest University School of Medicine / Advocate Health; Yongxin Guo - Wake Forest University School of Medicine; Onur Can Koyun - Advocate Health; Zhengjie Zhu - Wake Forest University School of Medicine; Abbas Alili - Advocate Health; Metin Nafi Gurcan - Wake Forest University School of Medicine
papers.intro: 本文提出NSVQ，一种非平稳感知的VQ训练策略，通过引入密集非平稳嵌入损失、码本替换和分阶段编码器冻结，明确地补偿编码器漂移，从而在不牺牲码本利用率的前提下提升重建质量。

papers.title: DarkVGGT: Seeing Through Darkness Using Thermal Geometry without Daylight Tax
papers.authors: Minseong Kweon, Wenyuan Zhao, Nuo Chen, Lulin Liu, Huiwen Han, Zihao Zhu, Srinivas Shakkottai, Chao Tian, Zhiwen Fan
papers.tags: depth estimation, pose estimation, 3D reconstruction, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: Minseong Kweon - University of Minnesota; Wenyuan Zhao - Texas A&M University; Nuo Chen - Texas A&M University; Lulin Liu - University of Minnesota; Huiwen Han - Stanford University; Zihao Zhu - Texas A&M University; Srinivas Shakkottai - Texas A&M University; Chao Tian - Texas A&M University; Zhiwen Fan - Texas A&M University
papers.intro: DarkVGGT提出一种物理启发的热-红外地几何融合框架，通过热分解和几何共享路由，在低光照下利用热红外信息提升3D估计精度，同时保留光线良好场景下的性能，避免了“日间税”。

papers.title: Semantic Segmentation of Node and Edge Diagrams for Assistive Technology
papers.authors: Michael Cormier, Yichun Zhao, Laura Paul, Cameron Swift, Duc Tri Dang, Miguel Nacenta
papers.affiliations: Mount Allison University（部分作者）、University of Victoria（部分作者）
papers.intro: 提出一种紧凑的双分支全卷积神经网络，用于节点-连线图的语义分割，在大规模合成数据集上达到93.7%像素准确率，为BLV用户辅助技术中的图表机器可读化提供轻量级基础。

papers.title: TRON: Tracing Rays to Orchestrate a Neural Renderer for 3D Gaussian Reconstructions
papers.authors: Or Perel, Hassan Abu Alhaija, Zian Wang, Jacob Munkberg, Matan Atzmon, Sanja Fidler, Masha Shugrina
papers.affiliations: 未明确（注：正文脚注显示NVIDIA, University of Toronto, Vector Institute，详见第十二节）
papers.intro: TRON通过将3D高斯射线追踪与神经渲染相结合，利用射线追踪提供结构化的辐射度量引导（PBR缓冲和辐照度缓冲），再由轻量级神经渲染器桥接域差距，首次实现捕获3D场景中动态几何、照明和材质条件下的交互式真实感渲染。

papers.title: ARM: An AutoRegressive Large Multimodal Model with Unified Discrete Representations
papers.authors: Junke Wang, Xiao Wang, Jiacheng Pan, Xuefeng Hu, Feng Li, Jingxiang Sun, Chaorui Deng, Zilong Chen, Yunpeng Chen, Kaibin Tian, Matthew Gwilliam, Hao Chen, Danhui Guan, Kun Xu, Weilin Huang, Zuxuan Wu, Haoqi Fan, Yu-Gang Jiang, Zhenheng Yang
papers.affiliations: Institute of Trustworthy Embodied AI, Fudan University; ByteDance TikTok; ByteDance Seed
papers.intro: ARM是一种基于统一离散表示的纯自回归大模型，通过精心设计的离散语义视觉分词器、大规模自回归训练以及基于强化学习的偏好对齐，在图像理解、生成和编辑任务上取得领先或竞争力性能。

papers.title: Next Forcing: Causal World Modeling with Multi-Chunk Prediction
papers.authors: Gangwei Xu, Qihang Zhang, Jiaming Zhou, Xing Zhu, Yujun Shen, Xin Yang, Yinghao Xu
papers.affiliations: Robbyant, HUST, HKUST, HKUST (GZ)
papers.intro: 提出Next Forcing框架，通过轻量辅助多块预测模块（MCP）同时预测未来多个视频块，提供密集多尺度时间监督，实现更快训练收敛、更高精度和两倍推理加速。

papers.title: Workflow-GYM: Towards Long-Horizon Evaluation of Computer-use Agentic tasks in Real-World Professional Fields
papers.authors: Liya Zhu, Jingzhe Ding, Jian Zhang, Jianbo Xue, Shihao Liang, Ge Zhang, Yi Zhu, Duju Zeng, Xiang Gao, Qingshui Gu, Mailun Gao, Huimin Che, Yan Zhao, Peiheng Zhou, Haojun Wang, Chaobo Xian, Lili Le, Chi Wu, Yiwei Liu, Shengda Long, Jiale Yang, Fangzhi Xu, Sijin Wu, Haodong Duan, Chao He, Zhaojian Li, Minchao Wang, Huan Zhou, Jiani Hou, Chuqian Yu, Weiran Shi, Hongwan Gao, Jiamin Chen, Guanhong Chen, Tingqin Luo, Kaiyuan Zhang, Zhixin Yao, Qing Hua, Yuhao Jiang, Jin Chen, Pu Chen, Zhenyu Hu, Xingyu Li, Zhengxuan Jiang, Meng Cao, Tianfeng Long, Haozhe Wang, Mingzhang Wang, Yichen Zhang, Yiming Dai, Chenchen Zhang, Jiaying Wang, Xinying Liu, Xingzu Liu, Lingling Zhang, Xinjie Chen, Yujia Qin, Wangchunshu Zhou, Zhiyong Wu, Yang Liu, Jiaheng Liu, Lei Zhang, Shen Yan, Wenhao Huang, Zaiyuan Wang, Xiaolong Chang
papers.affiliations: ByteDance Seed, M-A-P, Humanlaya
papers.intro: 本文提出Workflow-GYM，一个面向专业领域、长时、经济上有价值的工作流的GUI代理评估基准，通过多领域专家构建的338个任务，揭示当前最强模型成功率仅略高于30%的显著差距。

papers.title: Density Ridge Selective Prediction for LLM and VLM Hallucination Detection under Calibration Label Scarcity
papers.authors: Nina I. Shamsi
papers.affiliations: Northeastern University
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于密度脊（density ridge）的选择性预测方法来检测LLM/VLM幻觉，通过从生成过程中隐藏状态轨迹中提取六维运动特征，并在正确生成子集上拟合密度脊，以到脊的垂直距离作为置信度得分，在校准标签稀少（仅200个查询）的条件下取得了5-20个点的AUROC提升。

papers.title: Fisher-Guided Progressive Parameter Selection for Adaptive Fine-Tuning
papers.authors: Ghodsiyeh Rostami, Po-Han Chen, Mahdi S. Hosseini
papers.affiliations: Concordia University, Mila - Québec AI Institute
papers.intro: 本文提出FisherAdapTune，一种基于Fisher信息结构漂移的自适应微调框架，通过Jensen-Shannon距离追踪参数组曲率的时间演化，渐进冻结趋于稳定的层，从而在降低泛化误差上界的同时保持任务适应能力。

papers.title: Making Time Editable in Video Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Konstantin Kuklev, Viacheslav Vasilev, Alexander Kunitsyn, Andrei Ivaniuta, Denis Dimitrov
papers.affiliations: Kandinsky Lab
papers.intro: 提出一种基于显式时间分解（全局FPS控制+局部位潜在时间嵌入）的轻量级时间控制模块，扩展预训练DiT，使时间动态成为可直接编辑的变量，无需重新设计骨干网络。

papers.title: DB-3DME: From Dataset to Benchmark for Human-aligned Automatic 3D Mesh Evaluation
papers.authors: Nanshan Jia, Zhenyu Zhao, Sui Huang, Jingshen Wang, Zeyu Zheng
papers.affiliations: Nanshan Jia - University of California, Berkeley / Roblox Corporation（双标注优先以第一标注列UC Berkeley）；Zhenyu Zhao - Roblox Corporation；Sui Huang - Roblox Corporation；Jingshen Wang - University of California, Berkeley；Zeyu Zheng - University of California, Berkeley
papers.intro: 本文构建了一个包含2,619个合成3D mesh及其人工评分的数据集和基准（DB-3DME），系统评估了多个先进VLM，发现视觉编码是性能瓶颈，并通过对Qwen-2.5-VL-7B微调视觉编码器（冻结语言模型）实现了显著超越现有VLM的自动3D mesh评估能力。

papers.title: iSAGE: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework for Remote Sensing Semantic Segmentation via Sparse Point Supervision
papers.authors: Osmar Luiz Ferreira de Carvalho, Osmar Abilio de Carvalho Junior, Anesmar Olino de Albuquerque, Daniel Guerreiro e Silva
papers.affiliations: University of Brasília
papers.intro: iSAGE通过让专家直接点击模型稳定错误（自信错误）的像素，使用错误加权Dice损失训练，在无需任何辅助扩展机制（伪标签、CRF等）的情况下，仅用0.011%的标注像素就在ISPRS Vaihingen数据集上匹配了全监督基线性能（76.78% mIoU vs 76.65%），成为31种调查方法中唯…

papers.title: Maximum Matching Accuracy: An Instance Segmentation Evaluation Metric Utilizing Globally Optimal Matching
papers.authors: Kaden Stillwagon, Alexandra D. VandeLoo, Craig R. Forest
papers.affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology
papers.intro: 本文提出Maximum Matching Accuracy（MMA），一种基于全局最优二分图匹配和像素级全局归一化的无阈值连续实例分割评价指标，克服了现有指标的不连续、低敏感度和匹配非最优问题。

papers.title: A Controlled Audit of Pretraining Contamination in Public Medical Vision-Language Benchmarks
papers.authors: Bruce Changlong Xu, Lan Wu, Alexander Ryu
papers.tags: multimodal learning, medical image, visual question answering, CLIP
papers.affiliations: Stanford University; University of California, Berkeley; Mayo Clinic
papers.intro: 通过对四个开源医学VLMs在三个医学VQA基准上的四探测器审计，发现SLAKE-En存在图像源重叠信号且Qwen2.5-VL在文本侧存在交换性信号，同时证明基于群体的Min-K%++和跨模型top-K重叠信号在小型医学群体中因校准混淆而不可靠，但图像近邻和交换性探测器仍有效。

papers.title: Generalized-CVO: Fast and Correspondence-Free Local Point Cloud Registration with Second Order Riemannian Optimization
papers.authors: Ray Zhang, Marcus Greiff, Thomas Lew, John Subosits
papers.affiliations: Toyota Research Institute
papers.intro: 提出G-CVO，通过各向异性核嵌入局部表面几何信息，并结合二阶黎曼高斯牛顿优化，在无对应配准任务中实现比一阶方法快至10倍的收敛速度和更低的漂移。

papers.title: Latent Spatial Memory for Video World Models
papers.authors: Weijie Wang, Haoyu Zhao, Yifan Yang, Feng Chen, Zeyu Zhang, Yefei He, Zicheng Duan, Donny Y. Chen, Yuqing Yang, Bohan Zhuang
papers.affiliations: 浙江大学，微软研究院，阿德莱德大学，莫纳什大学
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种基于潜在空间的空间记忆（latent spatial memory）机制Mirage，将场景信息直接存储在扩散模型的潜在空间中，避免了像素空间的重建与编码，实现了更高效、信息无损的3D一致视频生成，并在世界生成基准上取得最先进性能。

papers.title: WeaveBench: A Long-Horizon, Real-World Benchmark for Computer-Use Agents with Hybrid Interfaces
papers.authors: Wanli Li, Bowen Zhou, Yunyao Yu, Zhou Xu, Yifan Yang, Dongsheng Li, Caihua Shan
papers.affiliations: 浙江大学、微软亚洲研究院、清华大学
papers.intro: WeaveBench是一个长跨度、真实世界、混合接口的计算机使用代理基准测试，包含114个跨8个领域的任务，每个任务都要求代理在单一轨迹内协调GUI和CLI/代码操作，并通过轨迹感知评估器来防止作弊，实验表明最先进模型和运行时的最佳通过率仅为41.2%，远未饱和。

papers.title: Temporal-Aware Reasoning Optimization for Video Temporal Grounding
papers.authors: Minghang Zheng, Zihao Yin, Yi Yang, Yuxin Peng, Yang Liu
papers.tags: video segmentation, multimodal learning, video generation, diffusion model, video search
papers.affiliations: Wangxuan Institute of Computer Technology, Peking University; Central Media Technology Institute, Huawei Technologies Ltd.; State Key Laboratory of General Artificial Intelligence, Peking University
papers.intro: 本文提出TaRO（Temporal-Aware Reasoning Optimization）框架，通过构建性推理探索和时序敏感性奖励，显式增强MLLMs在视频时间定位中"随时间思考"的能力，实现最先进的性能。
